identification: 'Woman in Bonnet': half-length young woman in a white bonnet and red shawl against a stormy sky and tree, oil on canvas, 43 x 34 cm, in a gilt-edged frame. Back shows an old stretcher and an inscription on the frame top ('...copy of ... portrait...', partly legible) with a luggage-tag label. Looks like a copy after an 18th C English portrait (Romney/Gainsborough school).
